method: Visual block-by-block transcription of all eight published Level 9 pages; PDF text extraction used only for cross-checking

copy.title: The Broccoli Fortress
copy.objective: Building a mood out of Bricks so the Wolf can't blow your house down.

copy.text:
Sunday dinner. 'Cake is dinner!' fought Alio, guarding his plate with a fork like a knight. 'It has eggs! It's basically a sweet omelet!'

Mimi sighed, sitting down next to him. She squeezed her own hands together to shake off the frustration of cooking for an hour just to argue about cake.

Alio, your stomach talks to your brain. Cake is 'Straw'. It burns fast - whoosh - and leaves you tired and grumpy. Vegetables and protein are 'Bricks'. If you build your mood out of Straw, the Wolf of Grumpiness will blow your house down before bedtime.
Alio looked at the vegetable soup suspiciously.
I don't trust the green things. Dilo said the government puts microchips in broccoli to control our dreams and make us do math in our sleep. It really looks suspicious. Maybe it's listening to us?!
Mimi closed her eyes and took a deep breath (waking her Wizard).
Alio. Dilo has watched too many movies. Broccoli are little trees of power. No chips. Just vitamins.
Alio seems not convinced, still poking a broccoli floret. Suddenly, Nini sprinkled some edible glitter on the table.
Alio, don't you know? Broccoli is magical! It doesn't have chips... it has X-Ray Fuel. If you eat it, you will have super-vision!
Seriously? I'll see through walls? And see what Dilo hides under his bed?
Of course! But you need at least three trees to activate the power.
Alio immediately stuffed the broccoli into his mouth. Crunch, crunch. 'I'm eating Bricks! I'm building a Fortress! Dilo, beware, X-Ray Alio is coming for your secrets!'
Can I have a little bit of Straw for the roof? Every fortress needs a decoration.
Mimi smiled and put a small cookie next to his soup.
Yes. A strong house can handle a little bit of straw on top. But the walls must be brick.
Alio's naivety is the only way to get him to eat vegetables. Genius strategy, Nini.
Build your body with bricks so your house is strong enough to weather any storm.

copy.heading: THE BRAIN SECRET (The Happy Juice)
copy.science: Did you know 90% of your Serotonin (The Happy Juice) is made in your tummy, not your head? What you eat literally becomes your feelings. Food is Mood!
copy.in_story: Mimi explained that cake (sugar) burns fast like straw, leaving you grumpy. Vegetables and protein (Bricks) give you steady power to be happy and strong.

copy.heading: THE TOOL ('The Colour Game')
copy.science: Your brain needs different materials to build thoughts.
copy.in_story: Alio ate 'Green Trees' (Broccoli). Try this challenge: Eat 3 different colors at dinner. (Warning: Beige, French Fries, and Bread do not count as colors!)

copy.heading: THE GLITCH ('I am HANGRY!')
copy.science: Hangry = Hungry + Angry. This happens when your blood sugar crashes. Your Brain Wizard goes to sleep because he has no fuel.
copy.in_story: If Alio only ate cake, he would be energetic for 10 minutes and then furious (The Wolf of Grumpiness). Fix: Never argue on an empty stomach. Eat a 'Brick' (nuts, cheese, fruit) first!

copy.heading: TALK ABOUT IT
copy.in_story: Alio wanted to build a 'Fortress' to spy on Dilo.
copy.your_turn: Are you building your body with Straw or Bricks today? How do you feel after eating too much sugar? (Jumpy? Then tired?)

copy.heading: FAMILY MISSION
copy.in_story: Nini used imagination to make food fun.
copy.your_turn: Look at your dinner plate. Point to the 'Bricks' (Protein/Veg) and the 'Straw' (Carbs/Sugar). Make sure your house is strong!

copy.heading: TOP SECRET SCIENCE (For Big and Small Brains)
copy.body: Why does sugar make me grumpy? Sugar gives you a huge spike of energy (The Zoomies!), but then your blood sugar falls down a steep cliff. That fall triggers stress hormones like cortisol. That is why you feel cranky 30 minutes after a candy bar. Protein (Bricks) releases energy slowly, like a log burning on a fire, keeping you warm and happy for hours.

copy.meaning: I am eating healthy protein or vegetables to build a strong mood that won't crash later.
copy.operation: Eat 3 Bricks (healthy foods) before asking for Straw (sweets).
copy.parent_says: 'Eat your vegetables or you get no dessert!',
copy.teach_to_say: 'Let's fortify your base! How many Bricks are we laying down for solid stats before we add the Straw roof?’
